# M4 validation — the inelastic design §6 protocol

*Generated by `design/py/run_validation.py --inelastic`: committed weights only (no training), 5 speed trials x 10 calls. Regenerate after any change to the model, the metric, the weights or the splits.*

L23 inelastic (X=1/2/4), 9960 samples x 81 lambda; 1992 held-out samples (elastic scene split). rRMS in `rrs` space vs `Rrs_X4`, all processes on, phi_C = 0.02.

## The acceptance gate — **PASSED**

The total-rRMS line is scored over **400-700 nm** (prompt 5 Q&A Q1: the model's stated domain — below 400 nm the Raman excitation clamps and the heads never trained). The full 350-750 nm grid is reported below, never gated.

| line | measured | bar | verdict |

| 1 total rRMS vs X4 | 0.343 % (worst zenith) | <= 0.5 % | PASS |
| 2 Raman delta incl. 0 deg | 1.03 % (worst) | <= 5 % | PASS |
| 3 fluorescence delta | 0.10 % (worst) | <= 5 % | PASS |
| 4 inelastic=None bit-identical | True | True | PASS |
| 5 gradients incl. phi_C | 5.9e-09 (worst of 6) | <= 1e-06 | PASS |
| 6 speed vs elastic hybrid | 1.67x (median) | <= 2x | PASS |

## Diagnostics (reported, not gated)

**a_ph(440) deciles** (held-out fluorescence 685 nm error; edges 0.0016-0.3527 m^-1): -0.22, +0.62, -0.28, +0.22, +0.05, +0.13, +0.12, -0.16, +0.30, +0.00 % — max |err| 0.62 %, flat across trophic state (the analytic term drifts -11 to +11 %).

**phi_C-linearity** (scaled-truth construction; 685 nm error per zenith at each multiple of phi_C = 0.02):

| scale | 0 deg [%] | 30 deg [%] | 60 deg [%] |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.5x | +0.076 | +0.072 | +0.103 |
| 1x | +0.076 | +0.072 | +0.103 |
| 2x | +0.076 | +0.072 | +0.103 |
| 5x | +0.076 | +0.072 | +0.103 |

Identical rows = linear by construction (design §4.4); truth exists only at 1x.

**emission_shape='double'**: vs 'single', median Rrs -8.5 % at 685 nm and +9.8 % at 730 nm; scored against the single-shape truth the 685 nm term sits at -23.6 %, -23.6 %, -23.6 % (0/30/60 deg) — consistent with moving 25 % of the emission into a shoulder L23 cannot see. Unvalidatable, off everywhere in v1.

## Caveats (measured, record §5-6)

- **Geometry**: the heads interpolate in cos(theta_s) over three zeniths; a delta_R trained without 60 deg errs by -74 % there (notebook 4 §3). Unseen geometries need coverage or a domain guard.
- **Domain**: lambda >= 400 nm (excitation clamp below), nadir view, L23-like water; phi_C-linearity has truth only at 0.02.
- **theta_s derivative** is one-sided at the packaged-Ed anchors (0/30/60 deg) — differentiate off the anchors (record §4.4).
